title: Make order placement atomic and thread-safe
prompt: Two problems with `OrderService.place` in shoplib/orders.py have been reported from production. (1) When an order has several lines and a later one can't be filled (or the same SKU appears on more than one line and the combined quantity exceeds stock), `OutOfStock` is raised but the stock for the earlier lines has already been deducted, and an order number has been used up. (2) The web app now calls `place` from a thread pool, and under load we see duplicate order ids and oversold stock. Make placing an order all-or-nothing and safe to call from several threads: either the whole order is placed (stock deducted, the next sequential id used) or nothing at all changes. Order ids must run 1, 2, 3... with no gaps or duplicates.
